secret_identity: Syndicate Links isn't an affiliate platform — it's an agentic commerce rail. Every commission row is a recorded handshake between two autonomous systems (merchant agent ↔ publisher agent).
spec_source: Hand-curated OpenAPI 3.0 derived from API-REFERENCE.md (the canonical SL docs, https://syndicatelinks.co/docs/api-reference). 52 documented operations spanning merchant (programs, products, conversions, refunds, webhooks, reports, billing) and publisher (registration, partnerships, tracking links, events, balance, payouts, agent attribution).
skipped_experimental: POST /merchant/refunds — partial refund (refundAmount param) not implemented
POST /affiliate/payouts/claim — Stripe and USDC methods (Lightning only today)

narrative_commands.intent: Mint an attribution token for an agent checkout
narrative_commands.note: Tested syntactically; not executed live (requires approved publisher partnership)

key_prefixes.aff_agent_: agent publisher — routes to /affiliate/* with agent privileges

live_smoke_results.merchant_list_programs: PASS — empty array (as expected for new account)

dropped_artifacts.mcp_server: Syndicate Links ships a hand-tuned MCP server (syndicate-links-mcp on npm) shaped specifically for agent commerce flows (7 tools). Press-generated MCP would have been 52 thin endpoint mirrors; we chose to keep the focused one and ship CLI-only here.
